stories.title: Entenda nova fase da Carbono Oculto, que atingiu executivo ligado ao Master

en.title: Understand new phase of Hidden Carbon, which reached executive linked to Master
en.summary: Brazilian authorities launched the third phase of Operation Hidden Carbon investigating money laundering through business and financial structures in the fuel sector, targeting an executive with connections to Master.

stories.title: Mergulhadores fazem inspeção interna de barragem com risco de rompimento no RS

en.title: Divers conduct internal inspection of dam at risk of collapse in RS
en.summary: Divers began inspecting the Arroio São Luiz dam in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, which faces imminent collapse risk. About 170 residents were evacuated and relocated to shelters.

stories.title: Trump recebe Xi na Casa Branca com votos de 'grande amizade'

en.title: Trump receives Xi at the White House with wishes of 'great friendship'
en.summary: US President Donald Trump hosted Chinese leader Xi Jinping at the White House for a symbolic state summit intended to demonstrate strong bilateral relations.

stories.title: Defesa Civil retira 170 pessoas de casa por risco de rompimento de barragem no RS

en.title: Civil Defense removes 170 people from homes due to dam collapse risk in RS
en.summary: Civil Defense authorities evacuated 170 residents from a community in São Marcos, Rio Grande do Sul, as a precautionary measure due to a dam collapse risk.

stories.title: Sandy & Junior sinalizam volta da dupla em 2027 – ação de retorno (financeiro) garantido na era dos megashows

en.title: Sandy & Junior signal duo's return in 2027 – guaranteed financial return action in the megashow era
en.summary: Sandy & Junior have announced a potential comeback performance scheduled for 2027, eight years after their previous reunion tour in 2019. The duo posted a cryptic message on social media with limited details, with full information expected in November.

stories.title: Relator, Toffoli vota no TSE para invalidar candidatura de Arruda ao governo do DF

en.title: Rapporteur Toffoli votes at TSE to invalidate Arruda's candidacy for DF governor
en.summary: Minister Dias Toffoli, the case rapporteur at Brazil's Superior Electoral Court, voted to invalidate José Roberto Arruda's candidacy for governor of the Federal District in the 2026 elections. Three additional ministers must support this position to reach a majority.

stories.title: Dino manda PF investigar suspeita de omissão da CVM no caso do Banco Master

en.title: Dino orders Federal Police to investigate suspected CVM omission in Banco Master case
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered Brazil's Federal Police to open an investigation into whether securities regulator CVM failed in its duty to examine suspected irregularities related to Banco Master.

stories.title: Sandy e Junior anunciam novidade para 2027

en.title: Sandy and Junior announce news for 2027
en.summary: Sandy and Junior have made an announcement regarding 2027.

stories.title: SIGA: Trump e Xi Jinping se reúnem na Casa Branca

en.title: FOLLOW: Trump and Xi Jinping meet at the White House
en.summary: China's president arrived in Washington on Wednesday and will remain until Friday. The two leaders will hold a bilateral meeting at the White House on Thursday, with artificial intelligence among the topics for discussion.

stories.title: Sandy e Junior anunciam projeto para 2027: 'Por essa vocês não esperavam'

en.title: Sandy and Junior announce project for 2027: 'You weren't expecting this one'
en.summary: The musical duo Sandy and Junior revealed on social media that they have a new project scheduled for 2027 in São Paulo, but chose not to disclose details at this time.

stories.title: Trump recebe Xi Jinping na Casa Branca e promete discutir IA e segurança global

en.title: Trump receives Xi Jinping at the White House and promises to discuss artificial intelligence and global security
en.summary: Trump and China's leader Xi Jinping meet at the White House, with plans to address artificial intelligence and global security matters.

stories.title: Bolsonaro alega ‘liberdade suprimida’ e pede a Nunes Marques suspensão de pena de 27 anos

en.title: Bolsonaro claims 'suppressed freedom' and asks Nunes Marques to suspend 27-year sentence
en.summary: Bolsonaro alleged violation of his freedom and requested that judge Nunes Marques suspend a 27-year prison sentence.

stories.title: Número de assessores de investimentos cresce em 2,2 mil no ano, diz Ancord

en.title: Number of investment advisers grows by 2.2 thousand in the year, says Ancord
en.summary: Brazil's registered investment advisers increased by 2,282 in the first eight months of 2026, reaching 26,640 total, with 75.2% working at financial institutions serving investors.

stories.title: Fusão entre Afya e Yduqs cria companhia com Ebitda 45% maior do que a Cogna

en.title: Merger between Afya and Yduqs creates company with Ebitda 45% larger than Cogna
en.summary: The combined entity from Afya and Yduqs merger would generate 20% higher revenue and 45% greater adjusted Ebitda than current sector leader Cogna.

stories.title: Ibovespa cai e dólar e juros futuros sobem com temores inflacionários no radar

en.title: Ibovespa falls and dollar and future interest rates rise amid inflationary concerns
en.summary: Rising oil prices and expectations of higher US interest rates weighed on Brazilian markets, with the Ibovespa declining while the dollar strengthened and future interest rates climbed.

stories.title: Se eleição indicar ajuste fiscal, Inter vê dólar abaixo de R$ 5 e alívio nos juros de mercado

en.title: If election indicates fiscal adjustment, Inter sees dollar below R$ 5 and relief in market interest rates
en.summary: A presidential election victory supporting credible fiscal adjustment could lower the dollar below R$ 5, reduce 2027 inflation expectations, and decrease market interest rate pricing.

stories.title: Ucrânia enviou dois soldados norte-coreanos capturados à Coreia do Sul, diz Zelensky

en.title: Ukraine sent two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea, says Zelensky
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that Ukraine has transferred two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea. He made the statement during a speech at the United Nations General Assembly.
